correctness.rationale: The exact Pfaffian criterion yields 448 smooth quadrics and 56 polar line subspaces with 256 lifts each. Finite projective orbit BFS partitions all 14,336 into five sizes; 15-point incidence matches the table. The affine Jacobian minors for both smooth-base representatives have unit ideals on all four charts by exact Buchberger reduction; the remaining types violate genus-one Hasse if smooth. Both scripts were rerun from their final candidate paths and printed success markers.

value.rationale: The statement solves the natural full orbit classification for the first small-field quadric-surface case from a published existence theorem. In addition to 14,336 pencils and five orbit types, it identifies precisely which 10,080 have geometrically smooth genus-one bases, their two rational-point spectra and the 4,256 geometric base-singular counterexamples, a structural dichotomy not implied by constructing one pencil.
